longForm.heroHook: Two tiers. One goal: simplify and optimize viscosity testing across the Brookfield range.
longForm.heroLead: Running a viscometer well is one skill. Managing the data that comes out of it, consistently, compliantly, across a whole fleet, is another. DV360 handles the second part. It comes in two versions: Standard, for labs that need reliable data capture and analysis, and 21 CFR Part 11 Advanced, for labs that need electronic signatures, audit trails, and secure data management on top of that. DV360 integrates directly with Ametek Brookfield instruments, DV2Plus and the DVNext Rheometer range among them, giving those solutions a shared software layer for advanced viscosity testing beyond what an on-instrument touchscreen alone provides. What it simplifies: viscosity test setup and execution across the Brookfield fleet. What it adds: 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, where the Advanced tier is selected. Where it fits: any lab standardizing data management across multiple Brookfield solutions.

sections.title: Standard vs. 21 CFR Part 11 Advanced
sections.tabSummary: The core choice this software presents
body: DV360 software tiers: the core choice this solution presents.
Not every lab needs an electronic audit trail. Every regulated lab does. DV360 splits along that exact line rather than forcing every customer into the same feature set.

Standard covers general viscosity testing, connected to the Brookfield instrument it's paired with, giving labs advanced testing capability beyond what an on-instrument touchscreen alone delivers. The 21 CFR Part 11 Advanced tier adds what regulated environments specifically require, referenced on DV2Plus's own product page as covering electronic compliance for pharmaceutical and chemical QC work.
